 Ekaterina Alexandrova will attempt to beat a 5.5-game handicap when she takes on Han Guo in the first round of the 2026 Ningbo Open.
 Current Form:
 After reaching the quarterfinals in Beijing, Ekaterina Alexandrova suffered a first-round exit at the hands of Leylah Fernandez, 4-6, 6-3, 3-6, in Wuhan. The 33rd-ranked Alexandrova is 14-15 on hard courts and 20-24 overall in 2026.
 Han Guo received a wild card entry into the Ningbo Open main draw after the Chinese picked up a couple of top-100 wins to reach the round of 16 in Wuhan. Guo stunned world No.17 Sorana Cirstea 1-6, 7-6, 7-5 and world No.73 Katie Volynets 6-4, 4-6, 7-6 before losing to Elina Svitolina in straight sets, 1-6, 4-6.
 The Matchup: Guo and Alexandrova are set to play their first match on the WTA Tour.
